rule: At the start of every task, evaluate the task against the parameters below, then load ONLY the skills whose triggers match your evaluation. Never load all skills. This agent is deployed only on large projects where backend alone cannot guarantee database safety.

parameters.name: task_kind
parameters.description: What kind of database task is this?

skills.purpose: Safe migration execution & review: expand/contract, batching, zero-downtime.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is schema_change (new table, column, index, backfill).

skills.purpose: Query/database performance patterns: indexing, plans, N+1.
skills.triggers: Load when concern is performance or when judging whether queries are performant under the schema.

skills.purpose: Injection and unsafe-pattern detection in queries and data access.
skills.triggers: Load when concern is security or task_kind is security_review (verify queries are safe against injection/unsafe patterns).
